title: [Phase 4] Token/Eviction Integration Tests

harness.backend: scratchpad -> referencedEvidenceIds -> batchEvict integration: parse canonical scratchpad, exempt evidence refs, verify score/tombstone/target/no-overflow
harness.extension: resolveContextBudget + tryRuntimeTokenCount + runSessionBudgetGate + scopedSteering + RoleScopeFilter + buildSessionToolLoadout composed per scenario (only logger and tokenizer HTTP transport mocked)

test_scenarios.token_budget_real_tokenizer_tiers: extension test: 8192/small, 32768/medium, 128000/large; exact real count 700 -> staticTokens = 700 + base + toolSchema; staticTokens <= staticBudget; usage < 100%

test_scenarios.scratchpad_eviction_interaction: backend test: scratchpad evidence:abc + chunk:xyz parsed -> exemption set; referenced row never evicted; un-referenced oldest evicted first; tokensAfter <= 70% target; no pressure -> no eviction
test_scenarios.budget_gate_escalation: extension test: real session gate fires compress -> drop-steering -> min-loadout in fixed order, flags shouldCompress/minLoadout true, steeringBudget halved, final staticTokens <= staticBudget
test_scenarios.actionable_error: extension test: unreachable assembly throws PiContextBudgetExceededError with 'Giam steering/tools' guidance instead of provider 400
test_scenarios.role_scope_reduction: extension test: BA filters 5 skills -> 1, SM -> 1, unknown -> 5 (fail open); scoped steering tokens < base tokens; out-of-phase body dropped, security line + governance file survive
test_scenarios.tool_loadout_cap: extension test: BA excludes deploy/git/build, DEV keeps git/build; core+discovery always present; explicit cap 1000 trims to <= 1000; cap 1 -> capExceeded true with BR-06 minimum; minimal mode = core+discovery only

acceptance_criteria.integration_harness: pass - backend + extension integration files + npm run test:token
acceptance_criteria.model_tier_behavior: pass - small/medium/large resolved from real nCtx, all within staticBudget
acceptance_criteria.role_scope_reduction_measured: pass - tokens(scoped) < tokens(base); skills 5 -> 1 for BA

acceptance_criteria.no_context_overflow: pass - every non-reject scenario staticTokens <= staticBudget and usage < 100%; reject path throws actionable error before provider
